OUTPUT: landscape canvas (width > height); source-native recomposition, no stretching, cropping, or padding.
Use the dominant source image described below as inspiration and material grammar, not as a picture to recreate.
BORROW

SOURCE-ASPECT NOTE: measured source is portrait/vertical (1410x2000); this describes the reference, not the output canvas. Recompose its subjects, silhouettes, object relationships, light, surface and framing grammar on a landscape canvas. Keep subject proportions and source identity; no stretching, cropping, or padding to force orientation, no pasted source panel or unrelated replacement scene.
Representational source cues are a vocabulary of concrete fragments and relationships, not requirements for exact count, order, positions, or full-scene restaging. Recompose selected recognizable fragments into new groupings and negative space; do not rebuild the complete portrait lineup or backdrop. Palette and grain alone are insufficient.
Require at least one structural change to arrangement, grouping/object count, or spatial logic; scale shifts, cropping and surface distress alone do not count. Keep distinctive source silhouettes, motifs, light and material relationships recognizable in the new structure.
TRANSFORM
Lacquered cartoon pileup on flat cobalt blue, horizontal frieze procession: the heap unstacked into a low sliding parade along a diagonal sage-cream wavy-striped ramp, toothy puddle-mouths ringed in yellow on a tilted pink floor, a fanged black-red zigzag mouth gripping the far left corner. High in open blue, two pink raised hands lift an oval collage-face mirror. Flat frontal plate, thick black contours, airbrushed glossy highlights swelling shapes off the page. Lower edge dissolves into light-blue droplet teeth. Dense left, wide breathing cobalt right.
COMPOSITION
Do not start by duplicating the original source framing and object layout. Start from the strongest borrowed source elements, then recompose them through horizontal frieze procession with a single lifted emblem in open sky / flat frontal orthographic plate with poster-like layering and no vanishing point. pyramid heap unstacked into a low left-dense procession along a diagonal…; raised pink hands lifting the oval collage mirror alone into wide cobalt….
ANCHORS
Compose exactly 1 distinct source-native physical feature within the artwork: Pink raised hands lifting the oval collage-face mirror into open cobalt. Keep it large and visibly separable; never a counted symbol, card, pasted thumbnail or UI label. No painted indicators. No visible annotation glyphs or QA chrome. No registration targets, crosshairs, reticles or hollow target rings.
LIMITS
shadowless flat front light with airbrushed white specular streaks that make each flat shape bulge like lacquered vinyl; materials: glossy enamel-vinyl fills; soft airbrush sheen; thick black ink contour; flat cobalt printed ground; palette: cobalt ground with bubblegum pink, tomato red, sage, lemon, sky blue and cream, all bound by black contour. SOURCE-INSPIRATION LOCK: use the source image as material and grammar, not as a composition to copy. Borrow recognizable elements: palette, silhouettes, relationships, motifs, light, and edge pressure; visibly recompose them and change at least two of arrangement, scale, object count, crop, surface state, or spatial logic. No unrelated replacement scene, pasted source photo, or near-identical still life with tiny marks. No game HUD or debug UI.
